what: Step 17.5 proposes step6-checks recovery even though the existing Exit 4 contract says STALL_STEP=6 is already unrecoverable and the orchestrator must not attempt main-agent edits
scenario_or_breakage: A PHASE=checks stall can loop back into the same exhausted lint/check repair path or mutate the repo after the current contract deliberately marked it stalled
suggested_fix: Either update the Exit 4 contract and its structural tests to delegate STALL_STEP=6 to Step 17.5, or remove step6-checks recovery and classify these stalls as unrecoverable

what: The proposed step5-review recovery says to invoke scripts/review-and-fix.sh directly, but Step 5 is routed through scripts/run-step5-review.sh and review-and-fix.sh is a Family B script requiring the background+monitor envelope
scenario_or_breakage: Recovery may call a nonexistent path or bypass session-env forwarding, round-cap handling, paired sentinels, and live completion coupling
suggested_fix: Route recovery through scripts/run-step5-review.sh --mode loop with the same Family B background+monitor pattern, or fully specify a direct review-and-fix invocation with all wrapper-provided args and the monitor envelope

what: The proposed issue-input-file is described as title plus body for /larch:issue batch mode, but the batch parser only recognizes generic items that start with a ### title heading
scenario_or_breakage: A generated file beginning with [Bug] /implement stall: ... is parsed as zero items, so no larch bug is filed and later comment posting has no issue number
suggested_fix: Emit the generic batch shape ### [Bug] /implement stall: <class> at <step> followed by the body, or invoke /larch:issue single mode with --body-file and an explicit title

what: The plan adds a Step 17.5 prelude using current-implement-env-$PPID.sh, but /implement currently rehydrates from session-env.sh and there is no sourceable current-implement-env writer or contract
scenario_or_breakage: After a shell/context boundary the prelude is a no-op, leaving IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR or CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT unresolved for classification and recovery dispatch
suggested_fix: Use the adjacent Step 17/18 key-based rehydration pattern, or add a real sourceable current-implement-env writer plus security docs and tests before relying on that prelude

what: The classify contract includes same-cause-repeat but does not define any argv or input file that gives classify the prior FAILURE_SIGNATURE
scenario_or_breakage: The same-cause branch is either unreachable or implemented by reading undocumented state, making retry caps and tests drift from the documented interface
suggested_fix: Add an explicit --attempts-file or --prior-signature input to classify, or move same-cause comparison into stall-recovery.md and keep classify limited to emitting the current signature
